baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence عُتُلٍّ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ joins bodily harshness to social attachment through an explicit afterness hinge.
baseline_models.mechanism: Coarse forcefulness is presented first; بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ then makes the attached-outsider image a cumulative final diagnosis rather than an unrelated insult. Conduct and belonging become mutually interpreting evidence.

activation_trace.role: Harsh coarse forcefulness supplies the observable conduct that opens the diagnosis.
Afterness opposite beforeness turns the two descriptors into an ordered escalation.
The attached outsider supplies the terminal social diagnosis and makes belonging part of the behavioral portrait.

changed_reading.before: Two consecutive insults, one about temperament and one about pedigree.
changed_reading.after: An ordered dossier in which coercive conduct culminates in a diagnosis of contingent, intrusive belonging.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عُتُلٍّ and زَنِيمٍ combine forced movement of others with the speaker's own attachment to a group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The figure creates distance by dragging or driving others, yet remains socially secured by being attached to a collectivity. The pair supports a power paradox: insecure belonging is defended by producing exclusion and displacement for others.

activation_trace.role: Coercive dragging by force supplies the outward displacement imposed on other bodies.
Creating distance and separation supplies the social effect assigned to the coercive force.
The attached outsider supplies the figure's contrasting dependence on a borrowed group position.

changed_reading.before: A powerful brute who also happens to be an outsider.
changed_reading.after: A displacer whose coercion may function to defend the very attachment on which his position depends.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The refusal-to-move branch of عُتُلٍّ sits beside the dangling-attachment branch of زَنِيمٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two opposed material postures coexist: the figure refuses to be led or to leave his place, while also hanging from an attachment rather than standing independently. Remoteness in بَعْدَ sharpens the tension between performed solidity and actual dependency.

activation_trace.role: Refusal to be led or moved supplies rigid noncompliance as the first posture.
Remoteness from nearness supplies the separation against which attachment becomes conspicuous.
The attached dangling tag supplies dependence and visible suspension as the counter-posture.

changed_reading.before: Stubbornness and outsider status are separate defects.
changed_reading.after: The stubborn display of immovability masks a condition of hanging from, and depending on, an external attachment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coarse-person branch of عُتُلٍّ is followed by the attached tag and recognizable-outsider branches of زَنِيمٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The final noun can operate as a diagnostic sign: repeated harshness becomes externally legible, as though conduct has generated a tag by which its bearer is recognized. The focus can therefore concern recognizability, not only a claim about descent.

activation_trace.role: Coarse forcefulness supplies the inward character that the later sign makes legible.
The dangling tag supplies a visible recognition device for the character already described.
The attached outsider marked by badness converts the physical tag into a social diagnostic.

changed_reading.before: زَنِيمٍ reports an independent genealogical or group insult.
changed_reading.after: زَنِيمٍ is also the outward tag by which the preceding pattern of coercive character becomes recognizable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pen and ordered written line make the focus sequence resemble a recorded dossier. Within that frame, بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ is an editorial sequencing joint and زَنِيمٍ is a terminal attached annotation, so the list classifies rather than merely vents hostility.

activation_trace.role: The trimmed writing stick supplies inscription and frames the later descriptors as recordable evidence.
The aligned written line supplies serial order and gives the focus hinge an editorial function.
Afterness supplies the internal ordering joint within the putative dossier.
The attached tag supplies the image of a final annotation fixed onto the preceding record.

structural_cues: 68:1 places pen and writing before the descriptor sequence.
68:15 later contests written material as tales of the ancients, keeping the status of the record itself live.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, serial lines, afterness, and an attached tag; I extend that textual frame to the descriptor chain. A live alternative is that the opening writing image authorizes the discourse generally without turning this local list into a dossier.

changed_reading.before: An extemporaneous spoken chain of abuse.
changed_reading.after: A record-like classification whose last item is attached as a decisive annotation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The requested reciprocal softening carries both oil-coating and conciliatory accommodation. Set against the thick, coarse عُتُلّ image, it suggests not genuine softness but a lubricated social surface over a hard coercive core: compromise can be a technique by which force moves with less resistance.

activation_trace.role: Oil and what is painted on a surface supply a literal coating laid over the focus figure's hardness.
Soft accommodation and dissimulation supply the coating's social function as tactical conciliation.
Thickness and severity supply the hard substrate that the conciliatory coating does not alter.

structural_cues: 68:9 makes the desired accommodation reciprocal: if you soften or coat, they will soften or coat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coating, conciliatory softness, and coarse thickness; I infer a surface-over-core relation and assign lubrication an enabling role. The live alternative is a simple contrast between compromise and harshness with no layered mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The same coercive hardness may seek a polished, accommodating surface when that lets power operate more smoothly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence becomes a transport relay: a verbal prod initiates pressure, the gossip-bearer walks it through the group, transgression carries it across a limit, and عُتُلّ converts that circulation into coercive bodily displacement. زَنِيمٍ then identifies a carrier who is himself attached to the group he destabilizes.

activation_trace.role: Prodding that moves a thing supplies the initiating impulse for the relay of harm.
Walking with gossip supplies the carrier motion that distributes the initial pressure socially.
Crossing a limit unjustly supplies the boundary breach produced by the moving report.
Coercive dragging supplies the relay's culmination in forced displacement rather than speech alone.
The attached outsider supplies the paradoxical social position of the relay's carrier.

structural_cues: 68:11-13 gives a tightly consecutive run of person-descriptors whose surfaces move from speech, to walking, to transgression, to bodily force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each motion but not the causal relay; I infer that verbal pressure is carried across boundaries and culminates in displacement. The equally live alternative is an additive catalogue of independent habits.

changed_reading.before: A static list of unrelated vices ending in brute harshness.
changed_reading.after: A process model in which harmful speech is mobilized, crosses social boundaries, and matures into coercive removal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accumulated wealth and displayed sons can build a public structure of belonging by joining assets, dependents, and lineage claims. The attached-outsider image then shifts from a bare pedigree slur to a diagnosis of membership constructed and defended through resources.

activation_trace.role: Remote people contrasted with near kin supplies the kinship axis on which belonging is being negotiated.
The attached outsider supplies the socially added member whose position requires support.
Taking and accumulating wealth supplies material capacity to sustain the attached position.
Building by joining parts supplies the mechanism by which a public structure of belonging is assembled.
Sonship and attribution to an origin supply the lineage display used to naturalize that constructed position.

structural_cues: 68:14 immediately follows the focus with أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ, presenting possession of wealth and sons as an explanatory condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, kin-distance, wealth, construction, and lineage; I infer that resources can manufacture or stabilize social membership. A live alternative is that wealth and sons motivate arrogance without mediating belonging.

changed_reading.before: زَنِيمٍ is a fixed fact of birth external to the figure's power.
changed_reading.after: The figure's belonging is a status structure assembled from wealth and lineage display, with coercion helping defend it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus tag is externalized onto the body's most public projection. The immediate move from a recognizable attached mark to a marking action on the nose or snout reverses agency: the harsh figure who carries a social badge is promised a countermark that exposes rather than secures him.

activation_trace.role: Coarse personal force supplies the inward character that is about to receive an outward sign.
The attached dangling tag supplies the visible-mark image that the next ayah relocates onto the face.
The nose or snout supplies the exposed bodily site on which the countermark is placed.
The angrily arrogant snout supplies a behavioral bridge from coarse pride to public marking.

structural_cues: 68:16 immediately follows the wealth-and-sons explanation with a future marking action on the snout.
68:16 word 1 has root و س م under missing_branch_inventories; it supplies only the structural act of marking and is not assigned a branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dangling tag, a branchless marking action, and the nose or snout; I infer a deliberate countermark that makes character publicly legible. The alternative is that the future bodily mark is punishment without a backward lexical activation of زَنِيمٍ.

changed_reading.before: زَنِيمٍ is primarily a social or genealogical label.
changed_reading.after: It anticipates visible recognizability: a bearer already marked by conduct is about to be countermarked on the face.

context_deltas.mechanism: The attached outsider is no longer only someone excluded by a group. In the garden sequence he becomes a model for the false insider who controls entry: attachment grants enough position to erect a barrier against the poor, until the intended excluders discover deprivation applied to themselves.

activation_trace.role: A barrier between a person and what is sought supplies the gatekeeping action immediately before the focus.
The attached outsider supplies the false insider whose contingent position can be converted into gatekeeping.
An outsider mixing with a group supplies the contested entrant-role that the owners try to police.
The abasement of poverty supplies the vulnerable person against whom the social barrier is directed.
Deprivation and loss of what was sought supplies the reversal that reaches the would-be excluders.

structural_cues: 68:23-24 moves from whispered collective motion to an explicit plan that no poor person enter that day.
68:27 reverses the owners' intended deprivation into their own declaration of being deprived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, an entry barrier, a poor entrant, and reversed deprivation; I infer that the focus figure's insecure insider status can motivate exclusion of a weaker outsider. The live alternative is that the garden only repeats withholding and does not revise the belonging model.

changed_reading.before: زَنِيمٍ names the person whom a group holds at its edge.
changed_reading.after: It can also diagnose a contingently attached insider who proves belonging by controlling the edge against someone poorer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later questions expose classification as an operation: naming or making two classes equivalent, entering a name into a register, and invoking partners who could authorize the arrangement. Under that pressure, زَنِيمٍ becomes not just a fixed pedigree but a person socially inserted into a category without warrant.

activation_trace.role: The attached outsider supplies the focus case of membership added to a group.
Saying or naming a thing supplies classification as an enacted assignment rather than a neutral observation.
Entering a name into a register or group supplies the administrative mechanism of attachment.
Partnership and participation supply the claimed collective authorization for the assigned membership.
The stranger entering among people not his own supplies a direct spatial analogue for inserted membership.

structural_cues: 68:35 asks whether two morally opposed classes are to be made alike.
68:37 demands a book for the claimed classification, and 68:41 demands the partners who could support it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies naming, registry, partnership, and a stranger entering another group; I infer that the rhetorical questions audit the same attachment operation compressed in زَنِيمٍ. The alternative is that those questions concern only promised outcomes and do not reactivate the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: The noun reports a settled biological or tribal condition.
changed_reading.after: The noun exposes an unauthorized social act of naming, registering, and inserting someone into a category.

context_deltas.mechanism: The refusal-to-be-led branch of عُتُلٍّ becomes an early phase of a later bodily trajectory: one who would not yield when able reaches a moment when yielding or bending cannot be performed. Coercive hardness reverses into humiliation under coercion.

activation_trace.role: Refusal to be led or to leave one's place supplies the initial voluntary noncompliance.
Capacity to perform supplies the ability that is absent at the later summons.
Bowing the head and bending supply the yielded posture that hardened refusal can no longer achieve.
Breaking under coercion supplies the reversal of the figure's earlier role as coercer.

structural_cues: 68:42-43 contrasts present inability to bow with an earlier summons issued while they were sound and able.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, later incapacity, bending, and humiliation; I infer a path from practiced refusal to embodied inability. A live alternative is that the later plural scene is not meant to identify the singular focus profile diachronically.

changed_reading.before: عُتُلٍّ describes a stubborn temperament in the present.
changed_reading.after: Its refusal to yield is a trajectory: performed hardness can congeal into the future inability to yield at all.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agent-patient relation reverses. The figure characterized by violent dragging is himself taken degree by degree through an extended interval. Slow, solid control answers visible force: delay is not non-action but the medium of a stronger drawing process.

activation_trace.role: Violent coercive dragging supplies the focus figure's apparent agency over movement.
Taking degree by degree supplies the hidden counter-movement in which the dragger becomes the one drawn.
Extended time and respite supply the temporal medium through which the gradual taking proceeds.
Extended solidity supplies the counterforce's durability and prevents delay from reading as weakness.

structural_cues: 68:44 explicitly makes the gradual taking occur from where its objects do not know, and 68:45 pairs respite with a firm scheme.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies violent dragging, degree-by-degree taking, temporal extension, and solidity; I reverse the focus figure from mover to unwitting moved object. The alternative is that the later plural warning remains general and does not target the focus type specifically.

changed_reading.before: The عُتُلّ figure is an autonomous source of forced movement.
changed_reading.after: His visible dragging power is nested inside a slower process that is already drawing him without his awareness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's false attachment is placed against a later sequence of catching, threatened casting into exposed space, and selection with renewed proximity. Belonging becomes a reversible operation rather than a permanent pedigree: attachment can be spurious, severed, rescued, or legitimately reconstituted.

activation_trace.role: The attached outsider supplies the focus's mode of spurious or contingent incorporation.
A rope splice or connecting ring supplies the material image of an attachment that catches before separation.
Casting and throwing away supply the threatened severance from shelter and group.
The abandoned child supplies a socially charged image of belonging lost through casting out.
Open space without cover supplies the exposed condition outside protective attachment.
Selection and drawing near supply a legitimate reconstitution of proximity after threatened expulsion.

structural_cues: 68:49 makes rescue interrupt a trajectory toward casting into exposed space.
68:50 follows with selection and a changed placement among the صالحين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attachment, catching, casting, exposure, and selection; I generalize these into competing operations of belonging. The live alternative is that the later rescue concerns a distinct figure and should not soften or recast the focus's social diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: Belonging in زَنِيمٍ is an immutable genealogical status.
changed_reading.after: The focus names one defective mode within a wider field of attachment, expulsion, rescue, and warranted re-placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final opposition reenacts the two focus images as a tactic. The gaze nearly dislodges its target from his station, while speech attaches a madness-label after hearing the Reminder. عُتُلٍّ plus زَنِيمٍ thus becomes a compact template: unseat the person, then fix a discrediting tag to him.

activation_trace.role: Coercive dragging supplies the focus template for forcing a target out of position.
The attached tag supplies the focus template for fixing a visible or social label to the target.
Slipping a thing from its station supplies the attempted displacement enacted at the surah's end.
Physical eyesight supplies the channel through which the attempted dislodgment is directed.
Saying what was not so or attributing it to someone supplies the act of attaching the discrediting claim.
The covering of intellect by madness supplies the content of the verbal tag.

structural_cues: 68:51 coordinates a near physical effect of hostile eyes with a quoted madness-label uttered after hearing the Reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dislodgment by sight and an uttered madness claim; I map those onto the focus pair as a two-stage opposition tactic. The alternative is that زَنِيمٍ marks the hostile figure himself and is not a general image for labels he attaches to others.

changed_reading.before: The focus only inventories qualities possessed by one condemned person.
changed_reading.after: It also diagrams a repeatable tactic of opposition: force the bearer of speech from position, then attach a label that neutralizes his speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines two zoological, form-distant branches that reverse the expected negative register. It remains anchored in the exact focus roots and exposes a coherent contrast between enduring but non-generative strength and externally marked nobility. Downstream prose should present it only as an animal-material analogy, not as the lexical replacement for either focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عُتُلٍّ activates a strong she-camel that does not conceive, while زَنِيمٍ activates an animal bearing a mark of noble quality.

activation_trace.role: The non-conceiving she-camel whose strength remains supplies power preserved at the cost of generativity.
The noble animal identified by an attached mark supplies status displayed externally rather than proven by fruit.

changed_reading.before: The phrase condemns strength and low status in a straightforward human register.
changed_reading.after: As a contained animal analogy, it critiques power that stays strong by producing nothing while substituting an external status-mark for genuine fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the hired worker or guard branch is dialectal and less expected than coarse forcefulness. It remains valid as a focus-rooted personnel model and coheres with remote kin plus attached outsider. Downstream prose should qualify it as a possible retainer analogy, not identify the focus figure historically as a servant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The personnel branch of عُتُلٍّ, the remote-people branch of بَعْدَ, and the attached-outsider branch of زَنِيمٍ can form a retainer profile.

activation_trace.role: The hired worker, servant, or guard supplies delegated coercion rather than sovereign force.
Remote people opposed to near kin supplies marginality within an elite social orbit.
The attached outsider supplies the retainer's contingent membership in the group he serves.

changed_reading.before: The focus figure is himself the independent center of domination.
changed_reading.after: He may be imagined as an attached enforcer whose harshness is hired, whose access is delegated, and whose belonging remains contingent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it turns person-descriptors into a mechanical toolkit and uses distant cutting and arrow-preparation cues. It remains anchored in the focus's heavy prying tool and attached-tag branches, with packet context independently activating shaped tools and string-grooves. Downstream prose should render it as a social-machine analogy and preserve its speculative status.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عُتُلٍّ can image a heavy prying implement, while زَنِيمٍ can image an attached cut tag whose scope includes the projections of an arrow nock.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and trimming a hard object to shape supplies the fabrication logic for the material focus images.
The heavy tool for prying, digging, or striking supplies leverage that separates or uproots.
The attached cut tag and arrow-nock scope supply a coupling piece that receives and transmits force.
String grooves and preparation of the arrow nock reactivate the coupling detail inside the focus tag branch.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an individual's harsh personality and suspect membership.
changed_reading.after: As a contained mechanism, the figure is a leverage tool inserted to wrench others loose while serving as a coupling through which a larger social force is transmitted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface construction strongly favors ordinary afterness, while the cited branch carries ruin and curse by being put far away. It remains anchored in the explicit focus root and gives the hinge a coherent evaluative shadow without canceling its syntax. Downstream prose must say that banishment colors, rather than replaces, the temporal-cumulative reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ can retain normal sequencing while faintly activating the root's branch of being put far off as ruin or curse.

activation_trace.role: Coercive dragging supplies the conduct from which the evaluative expulsion proceeds.
Being far off as ruin or curse supplies a banishment-shadow beneath the ordinary afterness hinge.
The attached outsider supplies the paradoxical object of exclusion: joined to the group yet marked for distance from it.

changed_reading.before: بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ only orders one descriptor after another.
changed_reading.after: The hinge still orders the list but may also cast a contained shadow of expulsion: after coercion comes the judgment of being put far off even while attached.

strongest_changes: The focus changed from a static insult pair into a force-and-attachment mechanism: the figure displaces others while depending on contingent belonging.
Writing, marking, and later classification questions turned زَنِيمٍ into a terminal annotation, visible countermark, and unauthorized act of category attachment alongside its social sense.
The garden sequence reversed the attached outsider into a false insider who excludes the poor, while the later rescue sequence kept attachment and expulsion dynamically reversible.
The coercive mover was repeatedly reversed into the moved object: refusal can harden into incapacity, and the violent dragger can be drawn degree by degree without knowing it.
The final gaze-and-speech scene reactivated the focus as a two-stage tactic: dislodge a target from position, then attach a discrediting label.
summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots sustained several coexisting scales without collapsing into one gloss: bodily coercion, social boundary control, editorial annotation, visible marking, and mechanical leverage. Context repeatedly changed agency and direction, especially who attaches whom, who excludes whom, and who ultimately moves whom.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ carries only cumulative sequencing or also a faint remoteness or banishment coloring.
Whether later plural actors should be read as developments of the singular focus profile or only as analogous patterns.
Whether زَنِيمٍ chiefly activates social insertion, visible recognizability, or both at once in this focus.
How much weight the zoological, personnel, and tool branches can bear beyond explicitly qualified material analogies.
